question: What meditative and recitative practice involving Durgā and Sāvitrī is prescribed?
premises: Meditation on Durgā precedes the recitation.
The recitation count is one hundred thousand.
Sāvitrī is to be recited in the same manner.
inference: One should meditate on Durgā and likewise recite Sāvitrī one hundred thousand times.
uncertainties: sāvitrīm may refer to the Sāvitrī mantra or the goddess; taken as the mantra here
plain_english: Having meditated on Durgā, one should recite Sāvitrī one hundred thousand times, and likewise do so.
